productsProvided.question: Q. What products does CNX Energy provide?
productsProvided.answer: CNX Energy supplies solar modules, energy storage systems, and balance-of-system components for residential, commercial, and utility-scale projects.

odmOemManufacturing.question: Q. Do you offer private-label (ODM/OEM) manufacturing?
odmOemManufacturing.answer: Yes. CNX Energy provides OEM and ODM manufacturing services for solar modules and energy storage products, helping partners build their own brands with reliable production and strict quality control.

purchaseInclusions.question: Q. What do I receive with my purchase?
purchaseInclusions.answer: Every order includes the product, standard warranty coverage, and full technical documentation, with installation and logistics support available on request.

tier1Brands.question: Q. Which Tier 1 brands do you work with?
tier1Brands.answer: We work with a portfolio of Tier 1-certified brands across solar modules and energy storage, selected for proven bankability and long-term reliability.

largeProjectSupport.question: Q. Can CNX support large commercial and utility-scale projects?
largeProjectSupport.answer: Yes. Our manufacturing capacity and project team support large commercial and utility-scale deployments, from initial planning through delivery.

afterSalesSupport.question: Q. Do you provide technical and after-sales support?
afterSalesSupport.answer: Yes. Our team provides technical support and after-sales service throughout the product lifecycle, including troubleshooting and maintenance guidance.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data Current Nexus Group Limited (“CNX”, “we”, “us”) collects through this website, why we collect it and the choices you have.

s1.heading: Who we are
s1.body: Current Nexus Group Limited operates this website and is the controller of the personal data described here. You can reach us at the email address shown in the website footer.

s2.heading: Data we collect
s2.body:
Information you send us through our forms: name, company, email, phone or WhatsApp number, country, project details and any files you upload.
Newsletter sign-ups: your email address and language.
Technical data: IP address, browser type, device and the pages you visit, collected through strictly necessary cookies and, only with your consent, analytics cookies.

s3.heading: How we use your data
s3.body:
To answer inquiries and prepare quotations.
To handle warranty and after-sales requests.
To send newsletters you have signed up for — you can unsubscribe at any time.
To keep the website secure and understand how it is used, so we can improve it.
To meet legal and accounting obligations.

s4.heading: Cookies
s4.body: We use strictly necessary cookies to run the website and remember your cookie choice. Analytics or marketing cookies are only used if you accept them in the cookie banner. See our Cookie Policy for details.

s5.heading: Sharing your data
s5.body: We do not sell personal data. We share it only with service providers who help us run the website and our email (hosting, email delivery), with authorised CNX distributors when you ask for local support, and with authorities where the law requires it.

s6.heading: International transfers
s6.body: CNX works with customers and partners worldwide, so your data may be processed outside your country. Where this happens we use appropriate safeguards to protect it.

s7.heading: How long we keep data
s7.body: Inquiry and quotation data is kept for as long as needed to handle your request and our business relationship, and then for the period required by law. Newsletter data is kept until you unsubscribe.

s8.heading: Your rights
s8.body: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct or delete your data, to object to or restrict its use, and to receive a copy of it. To use these rights, contact us by email. You may also complain to your local data protection authority.

s9.heading: Changes to this policy
s9.body: We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows when it last changed.

meta.title: Cookie Policy
meta.description: Which cookies the CNX Energy website uses and how to change your cookie choice.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: Cookies are small text files stored in your browser. This page explains which cookies this website uses and how you can control them.

s1.heading: Strictly necessary cookies
s1.body: These keep the website working — for example remembering your language and your cookie choice, and keeping the dashboard login secure. They cannot be switched off.

s2.heading: Analytics cookies
s2.body: If you accept them, analytics cookies help us understand how visitors use the website (pages visited, time on page) so we can improve it. They are only set after you click “Accept all”.

s3.heading: Marketing cookies
s3.body: We do not currently use marketing or advertising cookies. If this changes, we will update this policy and ask for your consent first.

s4.heading: Changing your choice
s4.body: Use the “Cookie settings” link in the website footer to see the cookie banner again and change your choice. You can also delete cookies at any time in your browser settings.

s1.body: Product information, specifications and prices on this website are for general information. Final specifications, prices and terms are confirmed in a written quotation or contract.

s2.heading: Intellectual property
s2.body: Text, images, logos and other content on this website belong to Current Nexus Group Limited or its partners. You may not copy or reuse them without permission, except for normal personal or business reference.

s3.heading: Third-party brands and links
s3.body: Tier 1 brand names and logos belong to their owners. Links to other websites are provided for convenience; we are not responsible for their content.

s4.heading: Liability
s4.body: We work to keep this website accurate and available but cannot guarantee it is free of errors or interruptions. To the extent allowed by law, we are not liable for losses arising from use of the website.
